Class GraphThoughtDrain

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.swing.GraphThoughtDrain
final class GraphThoughtDrain extends Object
The model lane keeps the reasoning text. One paint waits on the event thread. A later chunk joins the text that paint will write. The event thread paints a coarse update.

  • Method Details

    • offer

      void offer(String chunk)
      The method keeps one chunk on the model lane. A null or empty chunk returns without a post. A paint that is already waiting is not posted again.
      Parameters:
      chunk - the reasoning text

    • take

      String take()
      The method returns the text that arrived and clears the wait. A later chunk can post one new paint.
      Returns:
      the text, or empty
